title: 第3章 我煮的不是饭是补气的神仙料理第4章 张大虎的心事
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
窗外月色冷凄，窗内灯影热烈。
攀谈一番，张大虎将一本烧火诀递给林江月便回屋睡觉了。
林江月听了张大虎的授业，知道修炼需先打通全身气脉，再利用灵气进行控火。
烧火诀总共七层，第五层以上需要炼气期三层才能修炼。
七天内林江月必须练成第一层，如若达不到，张大虎就要送她走，这是留下来的条件之一。
林江月洗漱完就上床研究“引气入体”。
书上说：气从丹田起，沿任脉上至膻中、百会，再循督脉下归丹田，同时分润十二正经行于四肢躯干。
林江月盘腿而坐念起口诀，一股暖流自丹田而发，不多时便走完全身。
【首次成功引入天地灵气】
【当前灵气杂质含量：四成。建议搭配食补提纯。灵力上限200200。】
脑海中的小字再次浮现，林江月服下一粒引气丹，再次冲击。
冲击失败，林江月又拿起一颗，识海中浮现一行字。
【你因灵气过多，无法精进】
林江月拿来烧火诀准备消耗一些灵气，再引气入体。
灵气从丹田出发，直冲指尖。指尖吐气，一团小火苗油然而生。
就这样消耗灵气，再引气入体，很快她的灵气储备达到峰值，便难以寸进。
想来，这就是所谓的瓶颈。
林江月拿出引气诀，文末写道：灵气积累、境界感悟、身心契合三者没有达到平衡，便形成了“瓶颈”，此时不应贪功冒进，而是寻找合适的时机。
下面还有一小行注解：若有心结未解，便是再多努力也无用。
林江月仔细看了这行字，是另外的颜色，想必是哪位前辈师兄留下的。

“心结？”林江月倒在床上，思量片刻。
“要是有机会暴揍一顿石问天，把他的脸打肿，再给他一拳让他摔个狗吃屎，就舒服了！”
“不过不能让他瞅见，他那个靠山我可惹不起。”
“有朝一日，你欺负我的我一定要十倍奉还。”
林江月想着如何找机会揍石问天，想着想着就睡着了。
或许是做梦也在想，或许是梦中真的成功了。
【检测到强烈的情绪波动（仇恨）】
【以此情绪为佐料，刺激神魂运转提升灵力上限0300。】
第二天一早林江月听见鸡鸣就起床烧火，她按照张大虎的法子，煮出一锅香气扑鼻的灵米饭。
张大虎吃完顿觉身体舒畅，似乎原本停滞的瓶颈突然松动了！
林江月吃完早饭把院子从头收拾了一遍，又回屋拿起引气诀和烧火诀练了起来。
【烧火诀一层：100100。】
“哈哈哈，我成了，我成了！这下张大虎他赶不走我了！”林江月开心地在院里跳舞。
天黑后，林江月将做好的饭端到张大虎面前，与他分享喜悦。
张大虎感慨林江月的进步，仅一天便达到一层，当年他可花了一个月。
“你明天就跟我去饭堂烧火，烧不好，你还是得走。”
张大虎摆出一副真“师父”的架子，让林江月又打了鸡血，晚上不眠不休，抓紧练功。
鸡打鸣、烧火煮早饭、再去饭堂。
灶火温香绕，堂间笑语扬；
晴光铺暖色，喜乐满庭芳。

饭堂里已有些人等着开饭，张大虎带着林江月走到后厨。
后厨有七八个马车大的锅，烧火灶跟人一般高，角落里放着几十根腿粗的仙木棍。
每个灶台里都堆满了吸热石，只需用灵火加热便能持续供热。
content_en:
The moonlight outside the window is cold and miserable, and the lights inside the window are warm.
After chatting for a while, Zhang Dahu handed Lin Jiangyue a book of fire-burning techniques and went back to the house to sleep.
Lin Jiangyue listened to Zhang Dahu's teachings and knew that in practice, one needs to open up the energy channels throughout the body first, and then use the spiritual energy to control fire.
There are a total of seven levels of the Burning Fire Technique. Above the fifth level, you need three levels of Qi Refining to practice.
Lin Jiangyue must reach the first level within seven days. If she fails to reach it, Zhang Dahu will send her away. This is one of the conditions for staying.
After Lin Jiangyue washed up, she went to bed to study "introducing Qi into the body".
The book says: Qi starts from the Dantian, goes up along the Ren channel to Tanzhong and Baihui, and then goes down along the Du channel to return to the Dantian. At the same time, it divides and nourishes the twelve main meridians and runs through the limbs and trunk.
Lin Jiangyue sat cross-legged and recited the mantra. A warm current came from her Dantian and spread throughout her body in a short time.
[The first successful introduction of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth]
[Current aura impurity content: 40%. It is recommended to combine it with dietary supplements for purification. The upper limit of spiritual power is 200,200. 】
The small words appeared in his mind again. Lin Jiangyue took a Qi-Entraining Pill and struck again.
The impact failed, Lin Jiangyue picked up another one, and a line of words appeared in the sea of ​​consciousness.
[You are unable to improve because of too much spiritual energy]
Lin Jiangyue used the Fire-Burning Technique to consume some spiritual energy and then introduce it into his body.
The spiritual energy starts from the Dantian and goes straight to the fingertips. He exhaled from his fingertips, and a small flame spontaneously emerged.
By consuming her spiritual energy in this way and then introducing it into her body, her spiritual energy reserve soon reached its peak, making it difficult for her to make any further progress.
Come to think of it, this is the so-called bottleneck.
Lin Jiangyue took out the Qi-Entraining Technique and wrote at the end of the article: The accumulation of spiritual energy, state of mind, and physical and mental integration have not reached a balance, forming a "bottleneck". At this time, we should not be greedy for success, but look for the right opportunity.
There is also a small line of notes below: If there are unresolved knots, no matter how hard you try, it will be useless.
Lin Jiangyue looked at this line of writing carefully. It was in a different color and must have been left by some senior brother.
"Heart knot?" Lin Jiangyue fell on the bed and thought for a moment.
"If I had the chance to beat up Shi Wentian so hard that his face would be swollen, and then give him a punch that would make him lose his shit, that would be great!"
"But I can't let him see it. I can't afford to offend his backer."
"One day, I will repay you tenfold for your bullying."
Lin Jiangyue thought about how to find an opportunity to beat Shi Wentian, and fell asleep while thinking about it.
Maybe I was thinking about it in a dream, maybe I actually succeeded in my dream.
[Strong emotional fluctuations (hatred) detected]
[Use this emotion as a condiment to stimulate the movement of the soul and increase the upper limit of spiritual power by 0300. 】
Early the next morning, Lin Jiangyue got up and lit the fire when she heard the rooster crow. She followed Zhang Dahu's method and cooked a pot of fragrant spiritual rice.
Zhang Dahu felt relieved after eating, and it seemed that the bottleneck that had been stagnant was suddenly loosened!
Lin Jiangyue tidied up the yard after breakfast, then went back to the house to pick up the Qi-Entraining Technique and the Fire-Burning Technique to practice.
[Burning Fire Technique Level 1: 100100. 】
"Hahaha, I'm done, I'm done! Now Zhang Dahu can't drive me away!" Lin Jiangyue danced happily in the courtyard.
After dark, Lin Jiangyue brought the prepared meal to Zhang Dahu and shared the joy with him.
Zhang Dahu lamented Lin Jiangyue's progress. He reached the first level in just one day. It took him a month back then.
"You follow me to the canteen tomorrow to light a fire. If it doesn't work well, you still have to leave."
Zhang Dahu pretended to be a true "master" and asked Lin Jiangyue to take another injection of chicken blood. He stayed up all night and practiced his martial arts.
The chicken crows, the fire is cooked, and then we go to the dining hall.
The stove fire is warm and fragrant, and the hall is full of laughter;
The clear light spreads warm colors, and the courtyard is filled with joy.
There were already people in the canteen waiting for the meal to be served, and Zhang Dahu led Lin Jiangyue to the kitchen.
There are seven or eight pots the size of a carriage in the back kitchen, the stove is as tall as a person, and there are dozens of thick fairy wood sticks in the corner.
Each stove is filled with heat-absorbing stones, which can be continuously heated by simply heating them with spiritual fire.
